_what: NUMBERS read by a person on the remake capture 'Shrine of Plains - 17.17' (third-party material: only these numbers are in the repo, never pixels). Valid area = the capture without the player bar: 1242 x 625 px (the bar starts at y 626). Units: H = the height of the hero in px at its own feet (about 75 px); fractions of the valid area (fx of the width, fy of the height). Eye + ruler on 2-3x crops: about +-5 px (+-0.07 H); a reading, not a measurement of the game.

hero.note: four heroes in a row; the red-armoured one in the middle foreground; 74-77 px each

route.note: dirt path: x 150-330 at y 450; x 300-410 at y 285

P.note: the rock at the bottom right: x 1005-1135 of 1242, y 592-703; only its top (33 px of 625) is inside the valid area, its base is below the bottom edge

F.note: no empty background anywhere: canopy mass on the right up to the top edge (x 565-1240, y 0-430), the roof of the shrine and dark vegetation on the left, grass and a dirt strip to the right edge
